notes:
v4.6.101 — Separate accounts: switch reloads the app, nothing is shared, config lives on the server

👥 PER-ACCOUNT ISOLATION
• Each signed-in account now keeps its own data (bots, API keys, settings, ledgers) in its own folder. Two accounts on one computer no longer share ANYTHING.
• Switching accounts now RESTARTS the app into the other account — a clean load, no leftovers from the previous account.

☁ STORED ON THE SERVER (lower local storage)
• Your keys (already) and your desktop config (bot registry + per-bot settings, secrets stripped) are stored per-account on the server. A switched account — or a fresh machine — pulls its config from the server automatically. Local files become a re-fetchable cache.
• One-time migration: your current data is assigned to your primary account on first launch (backed up). Your second account starts clean and loads its own config from the server.

Update via the in-app banner.
